prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Try Out Your Companion Controls", "Practice interacting with your pet on screen before placing them on your desktop.", "Looks Good, Launch Pet", "Pet Companion"]
1: []
2: ["Rendering & Preparing Your Desktop Pet", "We are calibrating your pet's animations, audio, and desktop physics engine."]
3: ["Configure Desktop Placement", "Choose where your pet lives on screen and how controls appear when hovered.", "Confirm & Start Desktop Pet", "Screen Corner Docking"]
4: ["Sign In to Secure & Restore Your Desktop Pet", "Logging in links your pet safely to your account so companion progress and custom data are never lost or reset."]
5: ["Extracting pet assets and calibrating desktop interactions..."]
6: ["Sign Certificate & Claim Bonus Desktop Toy", "Complete your companion's official certificate to instantly unlock a bonus desktop toy item.", "Reward Unlocked: Bonus Desktop Ball"]
7: ["Setup takes about 3 minutes. All preferences can be adjusted later."]
8: ["You can safely minimize this window. We'll send a notification when your companion is ready!"]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Follow a quick step-by-step guide to set up your interactive pet on your desktop."]
